scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run lint:php && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.clean: mkdir -p storage/framework/cache storage/framework/sessions storage/framework/views bootstrap/cache && find storage/framework/cache -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -exec rm -rf {} + && find storage/framework/sessions -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -exec rm -rf {} + && find storage/framework/views -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -exec rm -rf {} + && find bootstrap/cache -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -exec rm -rf {} + && php artisan cache:clear && php artisan config:clear && php artisan route:clear && php artisan view:clear && php artisan optimize:clear
scripts.permissions:fix: docker compose run --rm --no-deps -u root php-apache sh -lc 'mkdir -p storage/framework/cache storage/framework/sessions storage/framework/views storage/logs bootstrap/cache config && touch apache.error.log apache.access.log php.error.log && chown -R "${UID:-1000}:${GID:-1000}" storage bootstrap/cache config apache.error.log apache.access.log php.error.log && chmod -R u+w storage bootstrap/cache config'
scripts.backup:db: mkdir -p backups && docker compose exec -T mysql sh -c 'exec mysqldump -u "$MYSQL_USER" -p"$MYSQL_PASSWORD" "$MYSQL_DATABASE"' > backups/database-$(date +%F-%H%M%S).sql
scripts.upgrade:laravel: composer update laravel/framework --with-all-dependencies && php artisan optimize:clear && php artisan config:clear && php artisan route:clear && php artisan view:clear
scripts.upgrade:all: npm run upgrade:laravel && npm run upgrade:npm
scripts.test:quality: npm run typecheck && npm run format:check
scripts.test:all: npm run test:quality && npm run playwright
